All ten checks are done. Eight were re-aimed to what the screens draw now. Two were real game breaks, and I fixed those in the game.

- **Game fixes, shipped:**
  - **v34.63 (`cw-partywin`):** the party window is the 90 percent card again, as Q43 says. This fixes v31.62 and v20.00.
  - **v34.64 (`cw-partyalign`):** the party window content now starts at the top left.
- **Checks re-aimed (kept to what each check tests, no loosening):**
  - **End cards (v34.32):** v29.95 and v29.83 now expect the 32px title and the 80px loss tile. v29.53 expects the single ghost feedback button.
  - **Wirt (v34.34):** v21.00 tests same width and same top edge. v9.94 tests that each panel has its own border and a visible label of 19px or more, with clear air between them.
  - **Party window (v34.22):** v19.42 tests the trading line only when it is shown. v32.22 expects 16px. v32.82 expects the "invite code" placeholder and still tests that the code keeps its case.
  - **Check 34.22:** it now expects the 90 percent card.
- **Test result:** all eleven checks (the ten plus 34.22) passed on v34.63 when I ran them. I did not rerun them after v34.64, which only moved the party window content to the top left.
- **Pictures:** I took none of the end cards or Wirt, because only the checks changed there.
- **What to watch in your next playtest:**
  - **Wirt window:** look at the side-by-side gamble and offer panels. The offer's lime tab was dropped on purpose in v34.34.
  - **Party window:** it now fills the 90 percent card. The critic found the empty card thin, so I logged that as a question for you in `questions.md`.

TASK DONE
